name: concept-translation
author: OmniCortex
description: A bridge between two models' representations: fit a linear map from model A's layer to model B's on the same texts, then carry a concept direction (an emotion vector, an SAE feature, a steering vector) found in A over to B, with a held-out score that says how well the map holds.

jobs.title: Concept translation: fit A → B
jobs.help: Reads the same texts through both models (Hugging Face weights), pools each layer's residual stream per text, and fits a ridge map from A's layer to B's. Reports R² on held-out texts.

fields.name: texts
fields.help: a text file, one passage per line (a few hundred or more)

jobs.title: Concept translation: carry a direction A → B
jobs.help: A direction in A's layer (.npy of A's width; an SAE decoder row, an emotion vector) mapped into B's layer, normalised, ready for B's steering.
